normative_extracts.quote: The Young Generation is divided into two semi-spaces, and surviving objects are evacuated to the To-space or promoted to the Old Generation.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: V8 Orinoco combines Cheney-style semi-space scavenging for short-lived objects with concurrent tri-color marking and compaction for the Old Generation.

production_failures.symptom: Periodic 40ms-120ms frame drops during smooth animations
production_failures.root_cause: Allocating thousands of temporary objects or closures per frame triggers frequent Young Generation scavenges and Old Generation mark-compact pauses.
production_failures.mitigation: Pre-allocate object pools or TypedArrays outside the animation loop to eliminate per-frame allocations.

production_failures.root_cause: FinalizationRegistry callbacks run asynchronously and are not guaranteed to execute promptly under tight allocation pressure.
production_failures.mitigation: Release large buffers and external resources explicitly with close() or dispose() rather than relying on finalizers.
